about_the_game:
Woken up suddenly, you play as Michael Salvatore, a father tormented by the sudden disappearance of his daughter, Haze..As you investigate Haze’s room, you’ll uncover tools — like the axe embedded in her bedroom wall — that may seem like  the only way forward.

LATE 2 ESCAPE: CHAPTER 1 includes a a twisted compelling story that gets better through each chapter.While playing Chapter 1 you will collect items that belongs to your daughter Haze.
   

 

Matches are your main sources of light — and your only comfort. Use them to

ignite candles that reveal hidden symbols, paths, or ward off the oppressive

darkness creeping in around you."Matches don’t grow on body bags — use them

like your life depends on it".

 

 

Found buried in the room of your missing daughter Haze, this axe is more than a tool

— it’s a turning point. Use it to shatter obstacles, and a variety of enemies.

Is it a weapon? A message? Or just the start of something worse?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences. It includes graphic depictions of violence, intense psychological horror, and disturbing imagery. Players may encounter unsettling scenarios involving blood, gore, and death. There are also themes of fear, suspense, and intense psychological stress that could be distressing.

Additionally, there may be moments of implied or suggested trauma, such as the threat of physical harm, psychological manipulation, and disturbing sound design.

Given the nature of the game, players who are sensitive to topics like graphic violence, horror themes, or psychological tension should approach with caution.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Phenom II X6 1100T
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti or Radeon HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 or Radeon R9 280X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: LATE 2 ESCAPE is a survival horror escape room game, where you play as  a retired soldier -Michael Salvatore who wakes up in his apartment , his daughter Haze is nowhere to be found and every room unravels a new piece of his broken past.
